verdict.rationale: The SDK explicitly documents running multiple agent tasks in parallel with `asyncio.gather()`. Agents can run on Docker, VMs, or any agent-server backend exposed over an HTTP/WebSocket API, and scheduled or webhook-triggered automations can fan out work. Cloud and Agent Canvas provide managed infrastructure and a control center for conversations. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or scaling guidance for many simultaneous tasks in Cloud/Enterprise, a fleet-level view for monitoring parallel runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput at scale.
